title: Supernode capacity
statement: The system shall accept at least 10 million incident edges on a single node with 0 rejected writes.
rationale: Hub entities (e.g. a popular product or account) overflow a single shard; the node's adjacency range is split across shards when it exceeds the shard size limit.

acceptance_criteria.text: Inserting 10 million edges on one node completes with zero rejected writes, and the node's adjacency spans more than one shard.
On that node, a one-hop traversal with LIMIT 100 completes within 50 ms at p99.
